convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for BykovTrend and ColorX2MA indicators which are non-standard; complex money management with MMRec (recovery) logic; multi-indicator signal confirmation

other_exits: Money management recovery (MMRec) may adjust lot size on consecutive losses; opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative input value=fixed lots mode; positive input value=deposit fraction mode; MMRec increases lot after consecutive losses to recover equity

custom_logic_notes: MMRec (Money Management Recovery) system increases position size after consecutive losses to recover account equity. The EA uses two custom indicators: BykovTrend provides directional signals (buy/sell arrows via buffer values), and ColorX2MA provides a trend filter (MA color change confirms direction). Both must agree for entry. Opposite signal first closes existing position, then opens new one. SL/TP pip values are adjusted by factor of 10 for 5-digit broker accounts.
python_conversion_notes: Both custom indicators (BykovTrend, ColorX2MA) must be reimplemented in Python or their logic extracted and coded directly. The BykovTrend indicator logic needs to be reverse-engineered from its .mq5 source. ColorX2MA is a double MA with color signaling - can be replaced with two MAs and a direction comparison. MMRec lot-recovery logic must be ported carefully: track consecutive losses and multiply base lot to recover. The digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit) must be handled in the Python framework's price-to-pips conversion. Entry uses previous bar indicator values ([1]) not current bar ([0]) - ensure correct lookback indexing in pandas.
